purpose: Convert backend test commands, route safety envelopes, audit proof, migration safety, billing test mode, staging smoke, and release rules into GitHub Actions workflow files and branch-protection evidence.

artifactPlan.note: Status, duration, commit, PR, branch, and required-check list.

artifactPlan.label: Denied access

artifactPlan.label: Data safety

cachePlan.note: Reuse package store while lockfile stays unchanged.
Cache build/typecheck output only for PR speed, not correctness.
Cache browser binaries for smoke tests when enabled.
Reuse seed fixtures only when fixture JSON does not change.
Upload coverage as artifact; do not restore stale coverage into checks.
Keep release reports tied to exact run id and commit.

secretPolicy.note: Disposable test database only; no production data.
Staging environment protected by manual approval.
Deterministic test secret for CI only.
Test-mode provider key, never live card capture.
Webhook signature tests and replay checks.
Temporary evidence/artifact storage for smoke tests.
Mail sink or sandbox provider only.
Restricted export proof for audit reports in staging.

branchProtection.note: No direct pushes; owner review required before production release.
Install, lint, typecheck, unit, contracts, envelope, audit, and release summary pass.
Tenant, access, commercial, redaction, and denied audit checks pass.
Migration, seed, rollback, restore, and count parity pass.
Billing workflows prove test mode, idempotency, and seat sync.
Integration branch accepts feature PRs only after base checks pass.
Release branch needs staging rehearsal before merge.
Preserve audit history, branch evidence, and release traceability.

matrixStrategy.label: Artifact retention

releaseGates.note: All protected workflows pass on the exact commit.
CI summary, route coverage, audit proof, denial proof, migration proof, and smoke report exist.
Secret scan and env example review pass before merge.
Cross-tenant and membership denial tests pass with request ids.
Operations routes and exports contain no restricted commercial fields.
Rollback and restore proof exist for the same schema version.
No live billing key can run in CI or staging alpha.
Release gate summary has owner signoff and next action.

adoptionOrder.title: Document release ritual
adoptionOrder.note: README and docs explain local proof, PR proof, staging proof, and go/no-go evidence.

acceptanceChecks.note: Eight GitHub workflow files have trigger, jobs, command scope, and artifact.
Twelve CI jobs map to commands, runner, cache, and proof artifact.
Twelve backend test commands are tied to workflow files and artifacts.
Eight branch rules define required checks and push restrictions.
Eight secrets are test or staging scoped with no live customer data.
Ten artifacts support engineering, security, migration, billing, and management review.
Eight go/no-go rules prevent blind merges.
v117 can turn this blueprint into first-commit workflow file contents.

handoff: v116 turns backend intent into enforcement: route contracts, error envelopes, audit evidence, migration safety, billing test mode, and staging smoke all become required workflow proof.
The future private repo should not rely on memory or manual checking. Every sensitive rule should produce an artifact that a reviewer can open.
Branch protection should only be enabled after the first workflow run proves the checks exist; after that, main and release branches should reject unproven changes.
The next build can create first-commit file contents for these workflow files, package scripts, README proof instructions, and branch-protection setup notes.
